segments.an10.84:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an10.84:1.3: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.an10.84:2.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ti.
segments.an10.84:2.3: Tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo samanuyuñjati samanuggāhati samanubhāsati.
segments.an10.84:2.4: So tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā jhāyinā samāpattikusalena paracittakusalena paracittapariyāyakusalena samanuyuñjiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno irīṇaṃ āpajjati vicinaṃ [visinaṃ (sī. aṭṭha.)] āpajjati anayaṃ āpajjati byasanaṃ āpajjati anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
segments.an10.84:3.1: “Tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasi karoti –
segments.an10.84:3.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ti?
segments.an10.84:4.1: “Tamenaṃ tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti –
segments.an10.84:5.3: Kodhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:6.3: Upanāhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:7.3: Makkhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:8.3: Paḷāsapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:9.3: Issāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:10.3: Maccherapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:11.3: Sāṭheyyapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:12.3: Māyāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:13.3: Icchāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.84:14.1: ‘Sati [muṭṭhassati (sī. syā.)] kho pana ayamāyasmā uttari karaṇīye oramattakena visesādhigamena antarā vosānaṃ āpanno.
segments.an10.84:14.2: Antarā vosānagamanaṃ kho pana tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānametaṃ’.
segments.an10.84:15.1: “So vatāvuso, bhikkhu ‘ime dasa dhamme appahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an10.84:15.2: So vatāvuso, bhikkhu ‘ime dasa dhamme pahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī’ti ṭhānametaṃ vijjatī”ti.

lines: Catutthe jhāyī samāpattikusaloti jhānehi ca sampanno samāpattiyañca cheko.
Atha vā irīṇasaṅkhātaṃ araññaṃ vicinasaṅkhātaṃ mahāgahanañca āpanno viya hoti.
Tattha dve mariyādā kilesamariyādā ca ārammaṇamariyādā ca.
Sace hissa rūpādike ārabbha rāgādayo uppajjeyyuṃ, kilesamariyādā tena katā bhaveyya.
Tesu panassa ekopi na uppannoti kilesamariyādā natthi.
Sace panassa rūpādidhamme āvajjentassa ekacce āpāthaṃ nāgaccheyyuṃ, evamassa ārammaṇamariyādā bhaveyya.
Te panassa dhamme āvajjentassa āpāthaṃ anāgatadhammo nāma natthīti ārammaṇamariyādāpi natthi.
Idha pana kilesamariyādā adhippetāti āha “kilesamariyādaṃ bhinditvā”tiādi.
